[color=#ffff00][head=3]Section 8: Escalation Guidelines[/head][/color]
[color=#a4885c]8.1[/color] Lethal force against players should be a last resort.
[color=#a4885c]8.2[/color] Don't disproportionately escalate in response to others' actions.
[color=#a4885c]8.3[/color] Don't ignore critical or dead players unless related to an objective.
[color=#a4885c]8.4[/color] Don't intentionally round remove other players unless related to an objective.
[color=#a4885c]8.5[/color] Revenge or "getting back" should be reasonable and proportional.
